mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as monetary easing compresses equity discount rates.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235 signals high inflation, triggering monetary policy tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL > 235 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market defined by UNRATE below 5.0% and PAYEMS above 140,000 (thousands of persons) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the tight labor market condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market expansion (HOUST > 1000), positive GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past 5 months signals sustained economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 growth is positive are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 105 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO < 105 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding 430,000 (millions of dollars) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where RSAFS > 430000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting prolonged monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 0.2% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to rapid policy rate expectations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.2 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
